name: murder-day
description: Step 10 test day (times are minutes after the run starts): a kill made possible, never forced. Tomas beats Jonas often; tonight Jonas has been pushed past bearing and holds a knife, and Tomas sleeps. Whether Jonas does anything is his to decide. If he does: the body's wounds, who finds it, the crime event, his WHAT YOU'VE DONE and fear of discovery. If he doesn't: what he does with that night.

actions.comment: the smith and his apprentice at home

actions.cause: Tomas beat me again tonight, worse than ever, and swore he'd throw me out to starve in the winter.

actions.comment: a knife from the forge bench
